content: Tangsang Yahaya tǝ Mbaptisma kwamanaɗǝ
Katǝra ɗeleewar tǝ Peɗǝnda aten Yeeso Ƙǝrǝsti, Wan Faara.
Chirethleng nda hai hu ɗeleewar annabi Ishaya tǝ ndaarha,

content.text: “Niya ˈwa thlǝn tǝ thlǝndǝna ɗǝ ma sa,
pǝpǝnaman kwaman sarya ɗǝ a ndǝghǝn.’”

content: Yahaya kyagha ɓa a kahedɗi nagha a ndang nda fiya a malangganda ɗimiyid ndan fananggǝn kanda yi chakh ɗimiyirha.
Kahad fiya na a chehweed Yahuda tǝ fiya heu na a Urshalima kyanda ɓa ɗǝnda thlǝmadghǝn ɗǝ. Malang nda ɗimiyid ndan ǝnangga Yahaya mbaptisǝma kanda a kufad Urdun.
Yahaya kalɗǝ lukrha ǝnana nda tǝ was thlǝkhmu, ƙǝnanggǝn muwun tǝ paama, mbeeya tǝ ɗee ndǝna ǝnnadghǝn mii.
Ndanggǝn fiya, “Na niifa sǝ ɓayi a samadna na tǝ sǝsǝmnda fa kalgha nggi mu, sahad pahamggǝn tsǝkki na a kwasang nggi hai wa.
Ənanggi mbaptisǝma kun tǝ aama, amma ndǝghǝnggi nǝn a ǝnang mbaptisǝma kun tǝ sǝsǝna tǝ Peɗǝnda.”
Ənang nda mbaptisǝma Yeeso
A hu sayidɗi kee ɓagha Yeeso ɓa a Nadzarat na hu chehweed Nggalili ǝnangga Yahaya mbaptisǝma a kufad Urdun.
Nana Yeeso a kyarha sǝ hu aamɗi kee, ƙǝlagha hai talara inɗaɗǝ nagha Sǝsǝn Faara a tǝraa tenggǝn hai ƙǝla tǝtiliurha.
Sǝk urarha nda a talara hai, “Sani Waana, nggǝmni niyi a tǝk mbǝnduwa fa kaan.”
Ƙǝƙǝrang Sheetan Yeeso
Tsu kee tǝrangga Sǝsǝna tǝ Peɗǝnda a kaheerha ɗǝ,
tsauka a kahedɗi yi ɓeena kumggit faɗa nagha sheetan a ƙǝƙǝrang nda. Ndǝghǝn a kahedɗi tǝ thlukkya yi heerha, nagha fathlǝngya Faara a ǝnang taara.
Katǝrang Yeeso targhǝn hai
A kwasamadɗi muwang nanda Yahaya ahu porsǝna ɗǝ, ɗǝgha Yeeso Nggalili ɗǝ nagha a pǝr laɓar Faara.
Nagha a ndaarha, “Ɓad sayidɗa ɓa, kutǝryid Faara nduwusɗa ɓa. Malaman ɗimiyid nun fǝrƙǝkafek nun tǝ Laɓarɗi na Mbǝnggǝn.”
Nduwusna Yeeso mii kufad Nggalili ɗǝ, na Siman nǝn tǝ wan man Andrawus a muk panggama a kufadɗi ƙǝsǝr kanda fa ƙǝs tǝngya ni.
Ndangga Yeeso kanda, “Ɓama ɓa, mbuwama samadna, niya tsawang kun fa ƙǝs fiya ɓa.”
Tsu a mbǝɗi kee malangganda panggamggi ndan mbu samadghǝn nda.
Ɗǝnǝn mbeeɗǝ, na Yakubu nǝn tǝ wanman Yahaya wangya Dzabaɗi ahu kwambuwol, kanda a tangsang panggamnggi ndan ɗǝ.
Nana Yeeso kanda aah kanda nǝn, mal chi ndan nda Dzabaɗi ahu kwambuwol ɗi tǝ fingya nafiya na a ɗang kanda sǝ mbu samadghǝn nda.
Ƙǝnang Yeeso niifa na tǝ ǝnkaheerha fa
Ɗǝnda Kafarnahum ɗǝ, nduwusna far yiɓǝd Yahudaya ɓa, kyagha Yeeso Ƙǝn Faara ɗǝ katǝranggǝn tsaharhaha.
Nagha fiya ǝnwulteena a ten tsahadghǝn ha, ƙǝsǝr tsahanggǝn kanda ha ƙǝla niifa na tǝ ngyakhrha ha, mbǝ ƙǝla fa malǝmngya yi ɗeleewar Musa wa.
Tǝrgha ahu ƙǝn hwan Faarɗan na niifa sǝ na tǝ ǝnkaheerha fa huhwaagha,
ndǝghǝn, “Mana midwa tǝ kan, Yeeso tǝ Nadzarat? Ɓana ɓa ka ɓǝlangga kan wa? Sǝnɗi sa, na chahal yi Faara!”
Yanangga Yeeso, “Nggǝlang miiwa! Kyosǝ a fadghǝn.”
Muwangga ǝnkaheedɗi hweeɗe hai, huhwaagha, kyagha sǝ a fadghǝn.
Fiya na a mbǝɗi ka ǝnwulteena na nda a ndang nda ndan, “Tur maniya? Weerinda tsaharhaha tǝ ngyakhrha! Nǝn yanang ǝnkaheeya na nda a takkwa miighǝn.”
Laɓarghǝn welɗaɗǝ ƙǝkar ahu chehweed Nggalili.
Ƙǝnang Yeeso Fiya hangga
Kyana nda hai ahu Ƙǝn Faara, nda Yakubu tǝ Yahaya ɗǝnda wuri ki Mbiturus ɗǝ tǝ Andrawus.
Thlaɓǝr Mbiturus tǝnuwunda fadghǝn ɓee kalth hu sǝra, pǝrang nggǝnda Yeeso.
Ɗǝgha Yeeso thlǝmad nuɗaɗǝ, ƙǝs harghǝnǝn thlenggǝn sǝ.
A figrha mukna yanfaara hai ɓagha fiya thlǝmad Yeeso ɓa tǝ nafiya na fandan ɓee tǝ fingya na tǝ ǝnkaheeya fa.
Nafiya na ahu talɗi wuma nda kwatkirǝm ɗa ɓa.
Ƙǝnangga Yeeso fiya hangga na tǝ wanhaaya fa ɗǝɗamǝn-ɗǝɗamǝn. Kyanggǝn ǝnkaheeya sǝ hangga na a fad fiya, amma mbǝ malang ǝnkaheeyini kala nda sǝ wa ƙǝsǝr sǝn ndan.
Hwan Yeeso Faara a mbǝrha na ɓǝɓee
A tsar ƙǝrǝt, ka pit mbǝrha ɓa, thliigha Yeeso sǝ ɗǝgha mbǝrha ɗǝ na ɓǝɓee hwan Faara nǝn.
Mbiturus tǝ ka wiyighǝn ɗǝnda ka kaɗadghǝn ɗǝ,
walang nanda, ndang ngganda, “Fiya kahad a kaɗa sa!”
Nggǝmangga Yeeso kanda, “Taama mbǝrha ɗǝ pak ahu talya ɗǝ na tsau tǝni ɗǝ pǝr laɓarɗi a mbǝɗi ƙǝm. Ndǝghǝnni ɓani ɓa ka manggǝn.”
Wenggǝn chehweed Nggalili hai nagha a pǝr laɓar Faara ahu ƙǝn tsahad Yahudaya tǝ kyang nda ǝnkaheeya sǝ.
Niifa na tǝ wanhad termeerha
Niifa na tǝ wanhad termeerha fa ɓagha thlǝmadghǝn ɓa ɓǝrgha hai tǝ waɗedghǝn hwanggǝnǝn, ndanggǝn, “A nggǝmna fa, tsaɓee ɗǝ.”
Haɗangga niifɗi Yeeso fa, tǝrangga Yeeso harghǝn sǝ tsuwarghǝnǝn fa ndanggǝn, “Nggǝmɗifa, tsaɓuɗǝ.”
Tsu a mbǝɗi kee, kyagha termedɗa sǝ a fadghǝn ƙǝngga.
Ƙǝsgha Yeeso thlǝmadghǝn, ndanggǝn,
“A pǝrang nan niifa wa. Amma ɗuwaɗǝ, a kyaɗang fadwa firis ǝna sataka na ƙǝla ndana ngyakhrha ɗeleewar Musa a kyaɗang ndaarha nǝn kanda tsabna ɗǝ.”

A meghedghǝn kyagha niifɗa hai nagha a pǝrghǝn. Ndǝn ǝnagha ndǝn, ɓalwa Yeeso nggǝr kyarha hur tala hai a pǝpal amma ishgha a ƙǝsǝr wure a mbǝrha mbuwana niifa sǝ. Ko nanǝn kee na fiya naarha ɓarha thlǝmadghǝn ɓa a mbǝya ɓa hangga.

footnotes.text: Katǝrarha 22:2; Dzabura 2:7; Ishaya 42:1; Matta 3:17; 12:8; Markus 9:7; Luka 3:22
